eligibility_criteria_text: Adults age 40-75 with hypertension; requires 3 clinic visits and stable antihypertensive therapy.
Adults aged 30-70 with type 2 diabetes and HbA1c > 7.0%; includes 4 visits over 12 months.
Patients age >=18 with persistent asthma seen in community clinics; 2 study visits.
Adults age 21-80 with solid tumor cancer receiving outpatient care; requires 5 clinic visits.
Healthy volunteer participants age 18-55; 2 overnight visits in sleep lab.
Adults age 18-65 with depression receiving telehealth services; 3 virtual visits.
Adults age 35-79 with hypertension and medication nonadherence history; 4 clinic visits.
Adults age 25-70 at high risk for diabetes in community prevention program; 3 visits.
